case_title: BROOKER, PAT VS WILLIAMS, DEMPSEY LEE et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,900.00 FILED BY BROOKER, PAT AS TO DEFENDANT WILLIAMS, DEMPSEY LEE MAD DOG EXPRESS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-08-2005 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
